question: An article is listed at Rs. 18000 and the discount offered is 12%. What additional discount must be given to bring the net selling price to Rs. 14414.40?
solution:
Given:

An article is listed at Rs. 18000 and the discount offered is 12%.

Final selling price = Rs. 14414.40

Concept used:

Selling price = Marked Price - Marked Price × Discount%

additional discount percentage = {{Initial Discounted Price - Final Selling Price } over Initial Discounted Price} times 100\%

Calculation:

The price after the first discount = 18000 - 18000 × 12% = RS. 15,840

Let the subsequent discount be of R%.

According to the question,

15840 - 15840 × R% = 14414.40

⇒ 15840 × R% = 15840 - 14414.40

⇒ 15840 × R% = 15840 - 14414.40

⇒ 15840 × R% = 1425.6

⇒ R% = 1425.6/15840

⇒ R% = 0.09

⇒ R = 9

∴ An additional discount of 9% must be given to bring the net selling price to Rs. 14414.40.
